an10.65:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā sārīputto magadhesu viharati nālakagāmake.
an10.65:1.2: athakho sāmaṇḍakāni paribbājako yenāyasmā sārīputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sārīputtena saddhiṃ sammodi
an10.65:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sāmaṇḍakāni paribbājako āyasmantaṃ sārīputtaṃ etadavoca
an10.65:2.1: kinnu kho āvuso sārīputta sukhaṃ kiṃ dukkhanti.
an10.65:2.2: abhinibbatti kho āvuso dukkhā anabhinibbatti sukhā
an10.65:2.3: abhinibbattiyā āvuso sati idaṃ dukkhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ
an10.65:2.4: sītaṃ uṇhaṃ jighacchā pipāsā uccāro passāvo aggisamphasso daṇḍasamphasso satthasamphasso ñātīpi naṃ mittāpi saṃgamma samāgamma rosenti
an10.65:2.5: abhinibbattiyā āvuso sati idaṃ dukkhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ.
an10.65:2.6: anabhinibbattiyā āvuso sati idaṃ sukhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ
an10.65:2.7: na sītaṃ na uṇhaṃ na jighacchā na pipāsā na uccāro na passāvo na aggisamphasso na daṇḍasamphasso na satthasamphasso ñātīpi naṃ mittāpi saṃgamma samāgamma na rosenti
an10.65:2.8: anabhinibbattiyā āvuso sati idaṃ sukhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhanti.
